name: Thread Tools — Large Active Room + Off-Focus Self Reports (108 messages)
flow: Multi-threaded; multiple threads cross ≥5 replies; self-reports trigger off-topic transitions
surfacing: Lineage shimmer + Grew lens + Topic Changes (off_focus) + NewSinceLastView manual reset

messages.text: Thread A: What’s the one decision we need first?
A1: Define success criteria.
A2: Agree on constraints and timebox.
A3: Name the audience for the outcome.
A4: What does “done” look like?
A5: I’d like a single sentence goal.
A6: If we can’t explain it simply, it’s not ready.
A7: Also clarify who owns follow-up.
A8: Maybe list 3 non-goals too.
A9: +1 on non-goals to prevent scope creep.
A10: Keep it tractable; one pass is better than perfect.
A11: Let’s pin the goal sentence first.
A12: Goal: make the room’s threads legible at scale.
A13: Add: without ranking or meaning mutation.
A14: That’s a good constraint anchor.
Thread B: What makes the UI feel “live” without being noisy?
B1: Micro-animations that are structural, not content-emphasis.
B2: Short pulses, not persistent badges.
B3: Avoid anything that looks like urgency.
B4: The thread spine is a good place for activity.
B5: Keep it subtle; otherwise it hijacks attention.
B6: Agree—pulse the lineage bar, not the message body.
B7: Also helps when threads are collapsed by default.
B8: This keeps it navigational: “something happened here.”
B9: Important: no unread semantics.
B10: And no sorting based on activity.
B11: If multiple threads update, pulses should be mild.
B12: We can cap pulse duration ~900ms.
B13: That feels like “alive” without being a badge.
B14: Could even refresh on replies, not just new roots.
B15: Yep—any new message inside the thread.
B16: This will read well in a busy room.
B17: Especially when collapsed; you still see motion.
B18: Keep it consistent across Trainer/Audience.
B19: Great—structural shimmer only.
Thread C: How should lenses behave in a high-volume room?
C1: One lens at a time; no stacking.
C2: Fixed thresholds; no tuning during facilitation.
C3: No velocity/trend charts; too semantic.
C4: “New since last view” should be trainer-local, not room-wide.
C5: Grew = discrete boundary crossing, not rate.
C6: Avoid implying urgency; purely structural.
C7: Also preserve canonical order (no re-sort).
C8: Lenses should be fast to use while speaking.
C9: And obvious when active (Viewing: ...).
C10: Clearing should be easy (All Threads).
C11: That prevents forgotten framing.
C12: In practice, the shimmer helps even without a lens.
C13: Makes the map feel responsive.
C14: But it must not become a scoreboard.
C15: Exactly—no ranking, just visibility.
C16: In a busy room, a few threads will naturally grow.
C17: Grew lens helps re-orient without claiming importance.
C18: NewSinceLastView is orientation recovery too.
C19: Good—keep everything structural.
Thread D: Any concerns with collapsing threads by default?
D1: Works if roots are readable and replies are one click away.
D2: Shimmer helps show there’s activity under the fold.
D3: Avoid hiding content permanently—expand should be trivial.
D4: Collapse is navigation, not suppression.
D5: If a thread is confusing, collapse still keeps the root visible.
D6: Great—keep it reversible and consistent.
D7: Also reduces scroll fatigue.
D8: Especially in an active room like this.
D9: +1. Keep it neutral.
Thread E: What should the “Grew” boundary be in practice?
E1: Start with ≥5 replies crossing.
E2: Keep it fixed; no trainer tuning.
E3: Make the window fixed too (like 5 minutes).
E4: It’s about accumulation, not value.
E5: Avoid making it feel like popularity.
E6: Yep—just structural.
E7: In this run, several threads should cross it.
E8: That’s good for validating the lens.
E9: And shimmer remains separate from “grew”.
Thread F: What does “New Since Last View” feel like in practice?
F1: Orientation recovery after you look away.
F2: Needs a single timestamp, not per-thread unread.
F3: A late burst helps validate it.
F4: And should not imply neglect.
F5: It’s not a to-do list; it’s navigation.
F6: You can reset by returning to All Threads.
F7: Exactly—clear framing.
F8: Then switch back to NewSinceLastView and see the delta.
F9: Perfect for stress testing the experience.
Thread G: Any UI risks we should watch for?
G1: Too much animation becomes noise.
G2: Make the shimmer subtle and brief.
G3: Avoid flashing the whole card.
G4: Avoid implying winners.
G5: Preserve equal dignity—nothing disappears.
G6: Also, keep canonical order stable.
G7: Works even when threads are collapsed.
G8: Great—structural shimmer only.
G9: This should feel alive without pressure.
Thread H: Quick check—does the room still feel legible?
H1: Mostly, but lens tools help in spikes.
H2: That’s why the allowlist matters.
H3: I’d use Grew to recover quickly.
H4: And NewSinceLastView when re-entering.
H5: The shimmer makes the map feel responsive.
H6: Agreed. It reads as “ongoing conversation”.
H7: And it doesn’t feel like a badge.
H8: Great. Let’s keep it subtle.
H9: Good run so far.
Late update on Thread A: I’m back—goal sentence still holds.
Late update on Thread B: Shimmer on structural chrome feels right.
Late update on Thread C: Lenses stay navigational; no meaning claims.
